title: Methane combustion bond inventory
hints: Broken bonds are on the reactant side.
solution: Methane has four C–H bonds. Two oxygen molecules have two O=O bonds total. Carbon dioxide has two C=O bonds and two waters have four O–H bonds.
statement:
For $\ce{CH4 + 2 O2 -> CO2 + 2 H2O}$, what bond inventory is used?

[_]{a}

choices: Break 4 C–H and 2 O=O; form 2 C=O and 4 O–H.
Break 4 C–H and 1 O=O; form 2 C=O and 2 O–H.
Break 4 C–H and 4 O=O; form 2 C=O and 4 O–H.
Break 2 C=O and 4 O–H; form 4 C–H and 2 O=O.
explanations: Both molecule-level counts and reaction coefficients are included.
This omits the coefficients of oxygen and water.
Each O₂ has a single double bond, with one tabulated double-bond entry.
